findings.evidence: Lines 53–55 identify the right-coset group as `Γ₂ᵀ`, while lines 67–68 identify the enclosing double coset’s other flank as `Γ₁ᵀ`; lines 204–209 themselves acknowledge that flank agreement is required to recover the level-one operator.
findings.fix: Distinguish choice-independence from the source-to-target invariance statement, and claim an endomorphism/action only when the relevant source and target groups agree (plus the stated double-coset identification).
findings.issue: Lines 27–35 and 212–216 say invariance under `Γ₂ᵀ` makes the sum “again invariant” and hence an action. For right-coset representatives in `Γ₂ᵀ δᵀ Γ₁ᵀ`, `Γ₂ᵀ`-invariance makes summands independent of representative choices, while right multiplication yields `Γ₁ᵀ`-invariance of the output; these are different groups in the generalized setting.

summary: The generalized documentation conflates choice-independence with preservation of invariance and therefore overstates when the sum becomes an action.
